name: Acceptance suite-3 test 91 - cross-account PassRole target
note: IAM-1005: iam:PassRole to a FOREIGN-account role (999900001111) + ec2:RunInstances, analyzed with subject account 123456789012. iam:PassRole passes a role only to a service in the SAME account as the role, so this is NOT a viable direct PassRole-to-EC2 path across accounts: the finding is reported but downgraded (not critical, low path-exploitability) with an explicit account-mismatch warning rather than asserting viability.
